candidate_evidence.quote: Fe-MRI uses ferumoxytol as a contrast agent with MRI.

role_evidence.quote: patients receive ferumoxytol intravenously (IV) over 10-15 minutes. Approximately 24-48 hours later, patients undergo Fe-MRI
